job.name: ig1_host_c
job.meaning: ведущий-мужчина ~30, короткая стрижка, аккуратная щетина, графитовый свитшот, на шее тонкий оранжевый шнурок-ланъярд без бейджа; лофт графит + оранжевая подсветка; по пояс, обе руки в кадре, лицо нейтральное, губы приоткрыты, без улыбки, фотореализм, без надписей
job.prompt: Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, of a real-looking person who could be a popular Russian Instagram creator — NOT a fashion model, NOT a stock photo, natural skin texture, believable. FRAMING (very important): waist-up, person in the centre, BOTH shoulders and BOTH arms fully inside the frame with generous margin (at least 12% of width) on left and right, hands relaxed at waist level holding nothing. Top of the head about 14% of frame height below the upper edge; face large and sharp. Expression: confident, lively eyes, face NEUTRAL as in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted with a hint of teeth, NO smile. Setting: a modern dark loft studio, graphite walls #111311 slightly out of focus, a warm orange #F3531B accent light (neon strip or rim light) behind, soft key light on the face — cinematic but natural. Clothes harmonise with graphite and orange. No text, no logos, nothing covering the face, no headphones, no microphone. A man about 30, Slavic features, short textured haircut, neat light stubble, a graphite crewneck sweatshirt, an orange #F3531B lanyard around the neck without any badge.
